noticias.titulo: Studio Gang completes women's leadership campus in Wisconsin
noticias.resumo: Architecture practice Studio Gang has completed a women's conference centre overlooking Geneva Lake in Wisconsin , with three irregularly shaped buildings informed by the site's oak forest. Located outside of Chicago on…
noticias.trecho: Architecture practice Studio Gang has completed a women's conference centre overlooking Geneva Lake in Wisconsin , with three irregularly shaped buildings informed by the site's oak forest. Located outside of Chicago on a lakeside hill, the Women's Leadership Center contains meeting spaces for established and emerging women in leadership roles to gather and "ideate solutions to complex issues within their industries". "Women leaders spend much of their careers in rooms that weren't designed with them in mind," said the center's founder Ann Drake, former CEO of supply chain provider DSC Logistics. "I wanted to build one that was." Studio Gang said key elements of the design were sustainability – with strategies such as a mass timber structure – and responding to the ecology of the site through gently curving volumes and wide-open windows. noticias.titulo: Visa has a new look by Base Design. So what’s actually changed?
noticias.resumo: The payment giant has had its first significant refresh since 2021, yet its famous wordmark hasn’t changed. So what’s new? And how far can a studio nudge a legendary brand that billions of people already know by heart?…
noticias.trecho: The payment giant has had its first significant refresh since 2021, yet its famous wordmark hasn’t changed. So what’s new? And how far can a studio nudge a legendary brand that billions of people already know by heart? We find out. It’s one of those logos you see pretty much every day but don’t think much about. Perhaps it’s because it means we’re about to spend some hard-earned cash. Or maybe we just don’t care. But you’ll know the Visa logo when it’s mentioned. It’ll flash up in your head as familiar as the faces of the people you love. So when you look at Base Design’s new identity for the brand, can you spot the difference? That’s what I find most fascinating about a job like this. When a logo is so famous and features on a zillion cards and on shop doors all over the world, how much room does a design studio really have to play with? Camille Summers-Valli Confronts the Invisibility of Female Ageing in Precisely Composed BIFA Short ‘Untitled Woman’
referencias.resumo: A particular kind of invisibility comes with growing older as a woman, especially in a culture that so often equates female worth with youth, beauty and desirability. It is this experience that Untitled Woman –which we…
referencias.trecho: A particular kind of invisibility comes with growing older as a woman, especially in a culture that so often equates female worth with youth, beauty and desirability. It is this experience that Untitled Woman –which we first highlighted as part of our BFI London Film Festival Best of Fest selection last month–captures so well and so delicately. Through a strikingly literal interpretation of the desire to be seen, filmmaker Camille Summers-Valli turns an everyday yet rarely acknowledged experience into a compelling visual exploration of the necessity to regain power while ageing. Through the lens of its protagonist, Dawn, we are asked a deceptively simple but increasingly resonant question: what does it mean to be seen in a world where images mean everything? And, perhaps more importantly, what role can art play in soothing the anxieties of a world so preoccupied with how we look, rather…

bolhas.resumo: Kalle Benallie ICT The Navajo Nation general election will have a recount. Crystalyne Curley and Chris Deschene declared the win for Navajo Nation president and vice president on November 3. The unofficial election…
bolhas.trecho: Kalle Benallie ICT The Navajo Nation general election will have a recount. Crystalyne Curley and Chris Deschene declared the win for Navajo Nation president and vice president on November 3. The unofficial election showed Curley and Deschene receiving 32,094 votes compared to 30,979 votes for Justin Jones and Emily Elllison.  The Navajo Election Administration had 10 days to certify the results but on election night Jones and Ellison requested a recount to the Navajo Board of Election Supervisors. It was approved.  The Curley and Deschene team sent to ICT a statement on November 11.   “The people have spoken. There’s no legitimate reason for a recount. We’re moving with building a strong administration. bolhas.resumo: Revisiting the Jade Terrace Alisan Atelier Hong Kong Sep 5–Dec 5, 2026 In 2014, Alisan brought together Zhang Yirong, Chu Chu, and Wang Mengsha in “Beyond the Jade Terrace,” an exhibition examining contemporary Chinese…
bolhas.trecho: Revisiting the Jade Terrace Alisan Atelier Hong Kong Sep 5–Dec 5, 2026 In 2014, Alisan brought together Zhang Yirong, Chu Chu, and Wang Mengsha in “Beyond the Jade Terrace,” an exhibition examining contemporary Chinese ink through the work of emerging female artists. In the years since, these women have established themselves as prominent figures in contemporary ink art, with aesthetically distinct practices rooted in tradition. Twelve years later, in celebration of the gallery’s 45th anniversary, these artists return, alongside fellow ink practitioner Zhang Ying, in “Revisiting the Jade Terrace,” which considers how their practices have evolved. The exhibition opens with Zhang Yirong’s meticulously detailed gongbi paintings.
